skills.title: Task Contract Designer
skills.description: Convert ambiguous LLM work into typed inputs, outputs, invariants and measurable evidence requirements using DSPy signatures.

skills.title: LLM Evaluation Engineer
skills.description: Build reproducible LLM and agent evaluations with leakage-resistant datasets, slices, metrics and confidence-aware reporting.

skills.title: Prompt Optimizer
skills.description: Optimize a measured LLM task's instructions and demonstrations offline with GEPA or MIPROv2.

skills.title: Few-Shot Learning
skills.description: Choose and validate demonstrations with LabeledFewShot and BootstrapFewShot without changing model weights.

skills.title: Self Refinement
skills.description: Use bounded candidate search and feedback-based correction (BestOfN, Refine) for verifiable outputs.

skills.title: Long Context Research
skills.description: Research large document corpora with RLM-style programmatic exploration, bounded subcalls and source-located synthesis.

skills.title: RAG Optimizer
skills.description: Improve retrieval-augmented generation with separate retrieval, grounding, answer-quality and efficiency metrics.

skills.title: Tool Use Optimizer
skills.description: Evaluate agent tool selection, argument construction and bounded recovery with ReAct or approved MCP adapters.

skills.title: Multi-Step Reasoning
skills.description: Build a small typed multi-stage DSPy program with verifiable intermediate artifacts.

skills.title: Model Cost Optimizer
skills.description: Choose model routing and optimizer configurations that meet measured quality/safety floors at lower complete lifecycle cost.

skills.title: Agent Architecture Evolver
skills.description: Experiment with program structure using DSPy Flex/GEPA under isolated code execution and independent review.

skills.title: AI Regression Gate
skills.description: Deterministically check quality, safety, provenance, cost and latency before independent release authorization.
